vendor_policy: The listed framework files retain the pinned upstream hashes. config.mk selects the portable host profile. scripts/ram/sram_fakeram.sv has an explicitly recorded local warning cleanup; all other listed framework files are unchanged. Clock boundaries, SRAM parameters, and the simulation protocol are retained. Machine-specific paths belong in ignored local config files.

config.mk.purpose: Select tools/verilator_low_memory.py and JOBS=1; export AppImage selection, TRACE_DEPTH=1, COMPACT_IDS=0, CPP_GROUP_BYTES=2097152, OPT_FAST=-O3, SPLIT_SCHEDULE=1, WORD_SIM=1 and UNROLL_STMTS=4096. Structural simulation, diagnostic names and compiler options remain configurable. PGO links use at most two LTO workers.

scripts/ram/sram_fakeram.sv.purpose: Add timescale and compute masked writes in an automatic function before the original nonblocking memory assignment, removing TIMESCALEMOD and BLKSEQ. SRAM interface, parameters, edge timing and SYNTHESIS branch remain unchanged.
